about: Index heavyweights for the hw_open / hw_day facts (lab/factory.py hw_series, same code live and in the Lab). Each entry is valid from its 'since' date; when NSE rebalances, add a new entry with a new date and keep the old ones, so past backtests stay the same. Weights are approximate index weights (share of the index); only their relative size matters. Bank Nifty: the three banks Ghanshyam Tech (9:20 setup) trades by: HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank.
